issue_1_repeated_404.root_cause: Superseded Railway deployment 4c70a120 ran code lacking 404 session retry handler, repeatedly calling get_positions with expired session until container was terminated by Railway.
issue_1_repeated_404.shutdown_cause: Railway orchestrator sent SIGTERM (signal 15) to retire old container 4c70a120 after new container a3eaf0a0 completed startup healthcheck.

issue_2_usdjpy_invalid_precision.root_cause: SYMBOL_MAP configured USDJPY point_scale as 1000 instead of 100000, sending 116 points (0.00116 JPY, 5 decimals) instead of 11600 points (0.116 JPY, 3 decimals). cTrader MCP rejected the 5-decimal SL on a 3-decimal symbol.
issue_2_usdjpy_invalid_precision.corrective_action: Configured symbol digits precision (USDJPY: 3, XAUUSD: 2, Forex: 5) and rounded distance before scaling by fixed 100,000 multiplier.
